name: Newonder Special Electric Co.,Ltd
summary: Newonder Special Electric Co.,Ltd specializes in the comprehensive development, production, and distribution of transformers. Their diverse product portfolio encompasses dry-type transformers tailored for applications such as variable frequency speed regulation, shore power supply, marine vessel power, oil and gas drilling, energy storage, and renewable energy systems like photovoltaic and wind power. Additionally, the company provides a range of oil-immersed transformers for energy storage, solar and wind power, general distribution, and various specialized uses, including converter transformers for frequency control. Complementing these are multiple reactor types, including synchronous switching, incoming and outgoing line, smoothing, filter, series, and SVG reactors. Established in 1985 and headquartered in Beijing, China, Newonder Special Electric Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of China Galaxy Securities Co., Ltd.
